jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Technology & Innovation - Control & Connectivity Solutions
jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Senior Manager, Technology & Innovation, you will shape the future of control systems used in off-road mobile machinery around the world. Leading a team of Architects and Innovation Engineers, you will define and drive the technology roadmap for next-generation Controllers, Displays, Remote Controls, and Joysticks, helping create the technologies that will power safer, more productive, connected, and increasingly autonomous machines.

This role combines people leadership, technology strategy, system architecture, and innovation. Working across our global Engineering and Portfolio organizations, you will turn customer needs, market trends, regulatory requirements, and emerging technologies into scalable platform solutions that enable future product development. You'll have the opportunity to influence key technology decisions, develop talented teams, and help bring new technologies from early exploration into real-world customer value.

The position is ideally based at one of our Danfoss Power Solutions locations in Northern Europe, with flexibility for other locations where local employment regulations allow.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Define and drive the technology and innovation roadmap for our Control & Connectivity Solutions portfolio, ensuring it supports future product and platform strategies.

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Architects and Innovation Engineers, creating an environment built on collaboration, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

• Own and govern key architecture principles and technology choices for future generations of Controllers, Displays, Remote Controls, and Joysticks.

• Build and manage a technology pipeline that moves ideas from exploration and proof-of-concept through technology maturation and handover into product development.

• Translate customer, market, regulatory, and technology trends into engineering opportunities, working closely with Portfolio Management, Product Management, Engineering, and Procurement teams across the global organization.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience leading and developing technical teams within engineering, technology, innovation, or product development environments.

• Great experience developing embedded and connected mechatronic systems that integrate electronics, embedded software, communication technologies, and mechanical design.

• Expertise in defining technology strategies, system architectures, technology roadmaps, or product platforms for complex products and systems.

• Understanding of functional safety, machinery regulations, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance within embedded industrial, automotive, mobile machinery, or similarly regulated environments.

• Ability to collaborate, influence decisions, and build effective relationships across global, cross-functional organizations.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• You'll lead a highly skilled technical team and influence the technologies and architectures behind future generations of machine control solutions.

• You'll work closely with senior leaders across Engineering and Portfolio Management, giving you visibility and impact on key technology and product decisions.

• You'll gain exposure to emerging technologies and help turn new ideas into scalable solutions used by customers around the world.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities. You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about, we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited by the opportunity to shape technology strategy, lead talented engineers, and help create the next generation of intelligent machine control solutions, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Strategy Director, Global Manufacturing & Supply IT
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As Strategy Director, Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS) IT, you will help shape strategic priorities and strengthen decision-making across a complex global organisation. Working closely with senior leaders, you will connect business and technology, create alignment across organisational boundaries and turn strategic ambition into clear direction and action.

**What You'll Bring

**We are looking for a strategic partner who fosters trust, align stakeholders, and creates clarity in ambiguous situations. To succeed, you will bring:

• Solid experience supporting senior leaders and leadership teams in a strategic, coordination or business partnering capacity, for example as a Chief of Staff, Senior Business Partner, Executive Assistant, management consultant or strategy professional.

• Strong stakeholder management across complex, matrixed organisations, with the ability to align diverse interests and influence outcomes without formal authority.

• A proven ability to influence senior leaders across functions and organizational boundaries, including VP and SVP-level stakeholders.

• Demonstrated experience shaping organizational strategy, operating models and leadership agendas in complex global organizations.

• A proven ability to structure ambiguity, connect competing priorities and translate strategy into actionable plans.

• Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex IT, digital and organisational topics into simple, business-relevant messages that land with senior stakeholders.

• Strong stakeholder intelligence, with the ability to understand what matters to key partners, anticipate concerns and ensure the right people are involved early enough to create alignment.

• Track record of leading strategic transformation initiatives with measurable organizational impact.

• Experience with strategic planning, portfolio prioritization, business case development and investment governance.

• The confidence to act as a trusted sparring partner to the VP, challenging and strengthening thinking, communication and follow-through before key leadership forums.

• A confident approach to using AI to work more effectively and bring modern ways of working.

• Resilience, discretion and a calm, senior presence in a fast-paced environment.

• Fluency in written and spoken English at a professional level.

• A master's degree in economics, business administration, finance or a related business discipline.

**In Addition, It Is Valued If You Have

**

• Experience from large, global matrix organisations such as pharmaceuticals, FMCG or consulting.

• Familiarity with IT or Operational Technology (OT) environments.

**What You'll Do

**You will act as the primary strategic coordination and integration point for the GMS IT Vice President and Leadership Team. The role is about ensuring the VP and Leadership Team operate with focus, clarity and influence, so GMS IT is seen as a strategic business partner across GMS and Enterprise IT. You will:

• Own the strategic planning process for GMS IT, ensuring priorities, investments, organizational capabilities and operating model decisions are aligned with GMS and Enterprise IT objectives.

• Drive continuous improvement of GMS IT leadership effectiveness, governance, decision-making processes and organizational performance.

• Help position the GMS IT Vice President and Leadership Team as a strategic partner by shaping clear narratives, framing dilemmas, preparing decision points and translating priorities into executive messages.

• Anticipate upcoming leadership moments, stakeholder concerns and business planning needs, ensuring the VP and Leadership Team are prepared, aligned and influential in senior forums.

• Represent GMS IT in key cross-functional and enterprise forums, influencing decisions and priorities that impact GMS-wide technology and digital transformation initiatives.

• Actively engage key partners across GMS Business Support and Enterprise IT, ensuring they are brought in early and sufficiently involved in business planning and leadership team discussions.

• Drive the business planning processes in close collaboration with Finance, People & Organisation and other key functions.

• Serve as a member of the GMS IT Leadership Team, driving preparation, follow-up and execution of leadership meetings.

• Provide leadership and direction across the GMS IT Business Partner community, creating alignment and consistency in strategic planning, communications and execution across the organization.

• Develop stakeholder engagement plans and prepare executive-level communications, leadership updates and strategic storylines that make GMS IT’s contribution visible and easy to understand.

• Drive follow-up on key initiatives, ensuring alignment and follow-through across functions and organisational levels.

**Who You'll Work With

**In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to bring molecules, processes, devices and products to the people who need them. You will be part of GMS IT, a global organisation spread across the world, working closely with the GMS IT Vice President and Leadership Team.

Your key partners will include Enterprise IT, GMS Business Support, Finance, People & Organisation, the broader Business Partner network and the Enterprise IT Executive Assistant network. You will need to know these partners well, understand how to bring them into the right discussions at the right time, and use that network to create stronger alignment around GMS IT priorities. You will navigate a complex matrix in a virtual setting with cultural awareness and agility, bringing different perspectives together to create clarity and momentum.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will join an environment where your expertise shapes decisions at the top of a global organisation. The role offers broad exposure across functions and leadership, the chance to influence how a senior leadership team operates and is perceived, and the opportunity to turn complexity into clear direction. You will be supported to perform at your best while working at pace with curious, ambitious colleagues.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 940,800 to 1,448,700 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring clarity, structure and strategic focus to a global leadership team, apply for the role by 15th November.

**Your impact begins here

**As Release Operations Manager, you will make sure every Novocare release reaches markets in a way that is consistent, scalable and compliant. You will lead the operational planning and rollout of Novocare V5 and ongoing releases across global markets, turning approved priorities into one clear, integrated plan. By keeping complex work visible and moving, you will help central teams, regions and affiliates launch with confidence, so Novocare support reaches each market reliably.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• A relevant degree in business, IT, engineering or project/programme management, or equivalent professional experience.

• Experience coordinating digital product or platform releases, multi-market rollouts or complex cross-functional programmes.

• The ability to manage integrated plans, dependencies, risks, readiness checks and stakeholder actions.

• A structured, dependable way of working that keeps complex work visible and moving.

• Clear communication and the ability to align teams without relying on line authority.

• A proactive, solution-oriented approach: you spot risks early, challenge stakeholders constructively when needed and escalate at the right time.

• A strong can-do mindset and a collaborative way of working.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• An understanding of product development processes and agile methodologies, including agile delivery.

• Familiarity with web/CMS or CRM environments.

• Experience in healthcare, pharma or another regulated industry.

**What You’ll Do

**You will own the operational backbone of Novocare releases, from planning through launch, stabilisation and learning. Within approved priorities, you will own the operational plan, release calendar and readiness tracking, and you will recommend sequencing or a readiness hold when quality or market readiness is at risk.

• Own and continuously improve operational rollout procedures, so every market and release follows a consistent, scalable and compliant approach.

• Translate approved priorities into an integrated release plan with milestones, dependencies, readiness gates and rollout waves, and maintain the release calendar, dependency map, risk log and decision and action tracking.

• Facilitate planning and readiness reviews, confirming owners, evidence, actions and escalation paths.

• Coordinate rollout waves with Market Enablement and regional contacts, covering market readiness, localisation, training, communications, support and cutover.

• Track delivery, quality and adoption, and prepare governance updates and post-release reviews.

• Build clear operational structures and keep improving them with what each release teaches you.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Novocare within the newly established Consumer Care unit, reporting to Mathias Bauer Munk, Associate Director Novocare.

In PPS (Product & Portfolio Strategy), colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale.

Your remit is global. Working centrally, you will partner with Novocare leadership and capability leads; product, platform, content and GBS publishing teams; QA, Compliance, MLR, Privacy, Data and Consumer Care specialists; and delivery partners, Regional Market Enablers and affiliates. Your role is to bring everyone together around one plan, raise risks early and keep decisions moving. Some travel may be required.

**What You Can Expect Here

**From day one, you will own a global rollout that connects functions, regions and partners. Clear priorities, honest feedback and fast decisions help the work move. Working with product, compliance, data and market teams, you will widen your perspective and build new skills on the job.

You will be trusted to make your voice heard, challenge constructively and help shape how Novocare releases are run, with support to grow as the platform and your role develop.

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring structure, clarity and momentum to global Novocare releases, apply for the Release Operations Manager role by 8 November 2026.

For further information, please contact Mathias Bauer Munk, Associate Director Novocare at mbmk@novonordisk.com

Are you passionate about developing people and helping leaders succeed? Introducing the People & Development Team

Why Join PEAK Wind

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to strengthen leadership and people practices in a business supporting the renewable energy transition

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

jobs.description:
Are you experienced in managing CMO collaborations and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders? Do you thrive in a broad QA role where you combine your GMP expertise with a pragmatic and hands-on approach across different quality areas?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new QA Specialist in QA Commercial Operations.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate QA specialist to join our team. You will be a part of the well-functioning QA Drug Substance/QA for QC team in the QA Commercial Operations department, with responsibility for quality oversight of starting materials, intermediates, and Drug Substances for commercial products. We have a close collaboration with our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and process- and QC SMEs internally at Ascendis Pharma.

Your key responsibilities will be:

As part of the role, you will work broadly across quality oversight activities and take ownership of a wide range of tasks and responsibilities, including:

• Take primary responsibility for oversight of one or more CMOs in our supply chains with respect to review and approval of documentation from these CMOs, including upscale activities, PPQ documentation, CPVs, batch documentation, deviations, changes, CAPAs, stability studies, QMRs, quality agreements etc

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key CMO stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and effective collaboration through meetings, teleconferences, and audits. Participate in CMO evaluations and product quality reviews

• Keep up to date with changes in relevant product guidelines and regulatory requirements and ensure cGMP at Ascendis and CMOs

• Drive and assume responsibility for agreed tasks and matters

• Continuously optimize our work processes and the way we execute quality oversight

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a master's degree in pharmacy or equivalent - and 5-10 years of experience within chemical and/or biological GMP production

Furthermore, you have:

• 
Solid QA experience, preferably including QA for QC, and experience working with CMOs

• 
Strong analytical skills, a collaborative mindset, and a can-do attitude

• 
Cultural understanding

• 
Experience with audits/inspections

• 
A critical and  pragmatic mindset and yet with attention to the necessary details

• 
Clear and persistent communication skills, particular regarding expectations and requirements to quality

• 
Cooperative and striving for smooth cooperation with many stakeholders

• 
Ambitious and able to see the benefits in going the extra mile

The position as QA specialist requires experience with and knowledge of US and EU GMP regulations and requirements. Furthermore, you should be proficient in English at a professional level, both written and spoken, and you master MS Office.

At Ascendis Pharma, you will be part of a stimulating, informal, and innovative working environment, where you will interact with very skilled colleagues and partners to deliver on Ascendis' ambitious corporate goals. You will be part of an expanding QA-organization overseeing development, clinical, and commercial activities.

Travel: 5-20 days/year.

Place of work: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the job or the company, please contact QA Senior Director, Jan Jakobsgaard, M +45 25 66 29 42 leave a message if call is not answered. All applications must be submitted in English and are treated confidentially.

You will be the first escalation point for team matters, and you will make sure decisions, risks and escalations reach the right level quickly and clearly.

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead a team that delivers reliable, compliant LIMS and Ecosystems services, apply by 16 November 2026.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a major global transformation and challenge established ways of working. It will suit an experienced procurement leader who enjoys bridging business and technology and driving change at scale.

**Key Responsibilities

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Developing the transformation roadmap, target operating model and benefit case for Global Procurement

• Representing Global Procurement in program governance and making timely decisions

• Driving simplification, harmonization and adoption across sites

• Ensuring processes, data and systems meet quality and regulatory requirements

**Technical Services Manager – VELUX Skjern

****Are you an experienced technical leader who thrives on combining strategic direction with operational excellence? Join our production site in Skjern and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of advanced manufacturing, driving technical performance, digitalisation, and continuous improvement across a highly automated production environment.

****Meet your future team

Together, the team plays a crucial role in ensuring equipment reliability, delivering technical projects, and supporting production excellence.

You will become part of both local and international leadership forums, collaborating closely with colleagues across Operations, Engineering, Quality and Production. **What We Offer

**In this role, you will lead technical operations across the site while supporting the organisation's strategic ambitions around operational performance, innovation and manufacturing excellence. You will have the opportunity to influence both people and processes, ensuring that technical capabilities continue to evolve in line with business needs.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

• Lead and develop the Technical Services organisation through values-based leadership, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, safety and technical excellence.

• Ensure high levels of equipment availability, reliability and performance across production operations.

• Develop and strengthen team capabilities within engineering, technical project management, maintenance and digitalisation.

• Drive equipment stability, process optimisation and digital transformation initiatives while delivering against operational KPIs and global standards.

• Identify, evaluate and implement innovative technologies, systems and working methods that enhance productivity, quality and efficiency.

• Support the installation, integration and optimisation of new machinery and production technologies across the site.

• Collaborate with local and international stakeholders to deliver strategic projects and share best practices across the organisation.

**What You Will Bring

**You are an experienced people leader who enjoys developing teams and creating an environment where individuals can perform at their best. You combine technical expertise with strong business understanding and are equally comfortable defining strategic priorities and ensuring successful execution.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring proven leadership experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment, preferably within a larger international organisation.

• Hold a relevant technical qualification such as Engineering, Production Technology, Marine Engineering or a comparable discipline.

• Have substantial experience leading technical, engineering, maintenance or project teams.

• Possess a strong understanding of Lean principles, operational excellence and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Have experience driving technical development, automation, digitalisation or production improvement initiatives.

• Communicate effectively across all organisational levels and build strong relationships based on trust, collaboration and mutual respect.

• Are fluent in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

You will keep financial reporting accurate, timely and compliant, especially at month-end and year-end, and help make accounting simpler and more digital. You will grow by working across markets, stakeholders and finance disciplines, and by contributing to how accounting is improved and digitalised across Business Area West. You will be supported by colleagues who give and ask for honest feedback so that everyone can perform at their best.

Content Specialist - PR & Journalism

Do you have a background in journalism or PR? Then you already have a head start. At Bonzer, your sense for a good story, sharp angles and solid research is exactly what makes content stand out – on Google, in the media and in the answers AI models give.

We're looking for someone who wants to be among the best content people in Scandinavia – and who sees every piece as a chance to get sharper.

About us

Bonzer is a specialised SEO agency passionate about helping businesses strengthen their online presence and visibility across Google and AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. That’s why we focus on crafting strong, organic strategies and SEO results tailored to our clients’ needs, goals and ambitions.

At Bonzer, we support our clients’ overall business and marketing strategy through in-depth analyses, strategic roadmaps and effective SEO sprints. We value close, honest and transparent relationships, both externally with our clients and internally with each other.

The role

As our new Content Specialist, you'll join a content team we're actively building and strengthening. You'll produce high-quality content for Bonzer's clients – content built to rank at the top of Google, earn coverage in the media and be visible in AI search platforms and language models.

Search is changing rapidly. More and more people find answers, products and brands through AI models. That's why journalism and PR skills are more valuable in SEO than ever. You'll work hands-on with this shift every day, helping our clients grow through organic visibility.

We want someone who's naturally drawn to exploring how new AI tools can make their day-to-day sharper. Not because someone tells you to, but because it's genuinely fun to figure out what's suddenly possible.

We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What we expect is that you bring strong craft, high standards and the drive to keep raising the bar.

Your responsibilities

• You'll create different types of high-quality content for our clients, such as blog posts, product and category texts, press releases, and graphic and interactive formats. Every piece combines strong craftsmanship with a clear strategic purpose.

• You'll drive Digital PR for our clients: find newsworthy angles in data and client insights, pitch stories and land coverage in global media.

• You'll create content that AI models pick up, cite and trust, helping our clients become visible not only on Google but also in the answers AI search platforms give.

• You'll explore how new AI tools can make your day-to-day work sharper – and share what you learn with the team.

• You'll own your tasks from start to finish. You'll keep an overview of multiple tasks and deadlines, take responsibility for the quality of your work and contribute to your team's shared goals.

Who you are

You have experience within journalism, PR, communication, content creation or similar areas.

Above all, you're a genuinely strong writer and know what makes a story newsworthy**.** You know how to create texts that are engaging, well-structured and tailored to different audiences and formats – and you take pride in delivering quality every time, even under deadline pressure.

Experience with SEO isn't a requirement, but we want to see a genuine interest in AI search, visibility in AI models and Digital PR. Just as important, you're curious about AI as a tool, not just as a topic.

You're organised and structured, and you take responsibility for your own performance. That's why we're looking for new colleagues who thrive in a collaborative environment, value community and share our values, so that together we can strengthen each other and the company.

You have high standards for your own work – you seek out feedback, study the best in the field and enjoy improving yourself. We value your character, craftsmanship and teamwork above all.

You'll thrive here if…

• you get a kick out of seeing your story in the media or your text at the top of Google

• you see feedback as the fastest way to grow

• you like a dynamic day where no two days are the same

Language requirements: You must speak and write fluently in Danish and English, and be a resident of Denmark, as the role is based at our Copenhagen office. Excellent Danish skills are essential for creating content for our Danish clients, and English is our primary working language across markets.

What we offer

• Dedicated support from day one

• Mentorship and skill development

• Working with exciting clients and brands

• Rapid development and career opportunities

• Valuable insight into SEO and the latest developments in AI-driven search

• Responsibility and independent tasks from day one

• Close collaboration with experienced and specialised colleagues

• A strong team culture with regular events and activities

• A growing team of 50 specialists across Denmark, Sweden and Norway

• An office in the centre of Copenhagen

How to apply

If you are interested in the role of Content Specialist at Bonzer, please upload your CV.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait. Expected start: December 2026.

We will get back to you directly if we see a potential match and invite you to a short introductory interview.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Working with Project Managers, Line Managers, Finance and IT, you will connect decisions on product development projects and resources with how projects are planned, prioritized, and followed up.

Together with colleagues responsible for other PMO systems and processes, you will help evolve how portfolio management is supported across R&D, ensuring governance, systems and planning processes continue to meet the needs of a growing organization.

The role offers the opportunity to deepen your experience in portfolio governance, business-system product ownership and cross-functional improvement, while working closely with stakeholders ranging from project teams and functional managers to senior leadership.

**

• Drive portfolio governance through Solution Steering Committee and Gate meetings, ensuring high-quality decision material, clear prioritization and effective follow-through on decisions

• Review and challenge project change requests and business cases, ensuring robust decision material and alignment with key stakeholders before submission

**Business Product Owner, XPM

**

• Align updates with IT requirements and drive delivery through the IT system owner and XPM vendor

• Train R&D users, maintain XPM guidance and align XPM use with Product Owners of other PMO systems

**

_**Would you like to play a key role in driving high-quality financial control, governance, and technical accounting across an international Group – with flexibility in how you structure your work?

**_Working on complex and business-critical topics, including audits, IFRS, acquisitions, and financial reporting, you will influence processes, shape best practices, and strengthen governance frameworks and internal controls across the Group.

Join us and build your expertise in a leading international healthcare company dedicated to improving the lives of people with intimate healthcare needs worldwide.

**Our Group Controlling and Reporting team is ready to welcome you

**At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will become part of the Group Controlling and Reporting team within Corporate Finance. Here, you will join a close-knit team of seven colleagues who support subsidiaries across the globe and are responsible for reviews, reporting, and controlling activities. **Be the key finance partner across the Group

**As Senior Financial Controller, you will serve as a key finance partner across the Group, providing expertise within IFRS, technical accounting, financial controlling, and governance.

This entails acting as a subject matter expert on complex accounting areas and being the finance contact towards acquired entities. You will also be the one to strengthen internal controls and governance frameworks.

Specifically, you will:

• Prepare accounting memorandums, supporting key accounting positions.

• Act as contact towards external auditors and prepare audit documentation.

• Own PPA preparation and follow-up in connection with acquisitions.

• Perform monthly controlling of subsidiaries and key business areas.

• Execute financial reviews and drive follow-up on identified risks.

• Handle and prepare annual reports together with the team for both the Group and the parent company.

**You combine strong financial expertise with a business-oriented mindset

**In this role, you need to have the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, taking ownership of activities and projects as well as engaging and collaborating with stakeholders across functions and geographies. Also, your exceptional business insight and perceptive mindset enable you to effectively organise and prioritise tasks, while identifying practical solutions to complex challenges.

Finally, we imagine that you:

• Hold an MSc in Business Administration and Auditing (cand.merc.aud.) or a Bachelor of Commerce (HD).

• May have experience from an accountancy firm, though this is an advantage and not a prerequisite.

• Possess a deep understanding of financial statements and accounting, including identifying issues and solutions.

• Have strong knowledge of the technical aspects of IFRS.

Set the direction for everything we build - and start hands-on

DOVISTA is building a new digital capability. Digital Innovation & AI brings enterprise architecture, digital innovation and AI together in one department with a clear purpose: set the direction for our future IT landscape, build the shared data, AI and integration platforms our solutions stand on, and build the digital products that make it easier for dealers, partners and colleagues to work with our brands.

We are looking for a Product Leader who will own the direction of every product the department builds, and who wants to roll up their sleeves from day one. Your first assignment is to be Product Leader for the digital products we are already building, and to take on the hands-on product management work yourself. There is a lot to define: vision, mission, scope, roadmap and the dependencies between projects. You will find the right people in the business and in IT, bring them together and make sure what we build moves both our KPIs and our architecture in the right direction.

About the department

Digital Innovation & AI is part of the group function Digital Solutions and has three areas:

• Enterprise Architecture - owns the IT target architecture, architecture principles and the architecture board

• Digital Innovation - builds new digital products for customers, partners and colleagues

• AI - builds AI solutions and the shared AI capabilities other products reuse across DOVISTA

Responsibilities

Own our new digital products, hands-on

• Define and anchor vision, mission and scope across our new digital products

• Build one integrated roadmap and manage dependencies to data, product master data, ERP, CRM and integration projects

• Own backlog priorities with the delivery teams, balancing improvements in live markets with the longer-term platform

• Run discovery with sales, sales support and dealers so we solve the real problems before we build

Align people and decisions

• Identify who in the business and in IT needs to be involved, and set up the stakeholder map and governance

• Facilitate alignment on vision, scope, roadmap and trade-offs, from working level to executive management and steering groups

• Communicate progress, decisions and value clearly and honestly across brands and markets

Tie every delivery to measurable value

• Define the KPIs that show whether a solution drives efficiency or growth, e.g. automation rate, quote lead time, hit rate, cost to serve and adoption

• Establish baselines before we build and track value after we release

• Use the numbers to decide what to build next, what to scale and what to stop

Build towards the target architecture

• Work closely with our enterprise architects so every solution fits the future IT landscape and moves us towards it

• Favour reusable business services, AI agents and shared platforms over one-off solutions

• Bring the product perspective into target architecture, architecture principles and the architecture board

Lead the product portfolio

• Own direction and priorities for all products built in Digital Innovation & AI

• Set the product practices the department works by, from discovery and OKRs to value tracking

• Help shape and hire the product roles we need in other parts of the organisation, as the portfolio grows

Shape data, AI and innovation

• Turn ideas into testable hypotheses and time-boxed experiments, and scale what works

• Work with AI architects and engineers on how AI quality is measured, evaluated and improved

• Build business cases for new digital products together with business owners

Qualifications

What you bring

• Significant experience in digital product management, including owning products end to end and setting direction across several products or teams

• A track record of delivering data- and AI-driven solutions that created measurable business value

• Experience driving innovation and digitalisation in a complex organisation with many stakeholders, ideally in B2B, manufacturing or multi-brand settings

• Experience with commercial processes such as quoting, CPQ, e-commerce or sales tools is a strong advantage

• Experience working with enterprise architects and platform teams, and an understanding of why architecture matters when you want to scale

• Experience engaging and influencing executives and steering groups

Skills

• You turn ambiguity into structure: vision, scope, roadmap and clear decisions

• You are a strong facilitator who builds alignment without formal authority

• You have commercial acumen and naturally frame work in KPIs and value

• You are technically curious, with a working understanding of data platforms, integration, APIs and modern AI such as LLMs and agents

• AI is not your only hammer. You know when a problem is best solved with AI, and when it needs rules, integration, data work, process change or conventional software

• You are a clear storyteller in writing and in person, and fluent in English. A Scandinavian language is an advantage

As a person

• Hands-on and happy to get into the details, while keeping the portfolio view

• Curious, pragmatic and driven by outcomes rather than output

• Builds trust quickly across business and IT, and across cultures

• Decisive, and takes ownership of your decisions

What we offer

• A rare chance to shape a new department and its product portfolio from the start

• Products with a direct and visible link to commercial results

• A leader who expects you to challenge, decide and own the direction

• An international group of brands with the long-term perspective of a foundation-owned company

Practical information

• Location: Horsens (DOVISTA HQ)

• Working model: We support flexible ways of working, recognising that the right balance depends on the role, the team and business needs.

• Travel: Some travel across Europe should be expected.

Want to know more?

If this sounds like the kind of role you're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We will be inviting for interviews shortly and will close the position once we have found the right match.

If you have any questions about the role, please contact the hiring manager Anders Butzbach Christensen, Senior Director, Digital Innovation & AI, at abut@dovista.com.

About Us

DOVISTA is a leading European provider of vertical windows and exterior doors. With 13 distinctive brands and approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets, the Group is locally strong and internationally connected, driven by a shared purpose to bring daylight and fresh air into people’s everyday lives.

Each brand has its own story, expertise, and strengths, yet all work to improve everyday living through quality solutions that meet our customers’ needs and shape homes and buildings that connect people with the world outside.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

**

**Core Skills And Experience

**

• Hands-on experience building and implementing enterprise SaaS integrations, not solely designing or overseeing them.

• Experience planning and executing complex customer migrations, including technical discovery, cutover planning, testing and issue resolution.

• Experience integrating enterprise business systems such as ERP, CRM, finance or data and analytics platforms.

• Strong customer communication, technical problem-solving and solution design skills, with professional English.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Experience

**

• Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business Central, Databricks, Salesforce, SAP or similar.

• Experience migrating customers between enterprise SaaS platforms, including data migration, system configuration and service continuity.

• Experience supporting both pre-sales solution design and post-sales implementation.

• Experience in EV charging, energy, mobility, IoT or similarly complex technology ecosystems.

• With experience supporting customers across Western Europe.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

_**Primary Outcome

_Design and deliver reliable enterprise integrations and successful customer migrations that accelerate onboarding, minimise disruption and enable revenue activation.

_**AI Competency

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• Analytics & ML: Langfuse, PyTorch, Mastra

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

We don’t expect mastery of all — but we expect comfort learning, experimenting, and adopting _AI responsibly.

_Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

**Please send us your application in English.
